title: Paperclip provides an open control plane for workplace agents
friendlyTitle: Paperclip helps teams organize many AI agents
summary: Paperclip is a heavily trending TypeScript project for organizing AI agents, tasks, budgets and approvals in one workplace-style application. The MIT-licensed repository has more than 84,000 stars and was receiving active updates during this issue’s collection window.
friendlySummary: Paperclip is a popular open-source app for managing agents, tasks, budgets and approvals in one place. It has more than 84,000 GitHub stars and is actively maintained.
whyItMatters: Teams can study or self-host it as an operating layer for multiple agents rather than managing each agent in a separate terminal. Its dashboards and controls are useful for testing clearer ownership, spending limits and human oversight.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it to explore a shared workspace where people can see what agents are doing and control their work and spending.
